title: Specialist handoff
description: The single format every specialist returns to the coordinator. Uniform handoffs are what make specialists composable: the coordinator does not need to know how the instrumentation analyst works in order to combine its output with the segment analyst's. Without a fixed handoff, a multi-agent system is just several prompts producing prose that someone has to reconcile by hand — which is slower and less reliable than one agent doing the whole job.

scope.description: What this specialist was asked to cover, in its own words. Used to detect two specialists claiming the same territory.

out_of_scope.description: What this specialist deliberately did not do, so the coordinator knows the gap is intentional rather than forgotten.

finding.description: An observation, not an explanation. Root-cause language belongs to the coordinator and only after the reviewer has passed it.

limitations.description: What this specialist could not establish. Required, and 'none' is almost never the honest answer.

recommended_next_step.description: The cheapest thing that would most reduce uncertainty. Not 'investigate further'.
